 This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e 
 following:
 Order

This claim under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred feeling aggrieved by the award dated 23-06-2022 in MACC No. 968/2021 passed by the 2nd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal for enhancement of Rs. 2 lacs compensation awarded for death of Rambharosa @
Rambharos.

2. Facts in brief are that a claim of Rs. 90,50,000/- was filed under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 for the death of Rambharosa, aged 45 years asserting the income of the deceased as Rs.
15,000/- per month from salary.
3. The respondent No.3 contested the claim.
The tribunal framed issues and recorded the testimony of Guddi Bai (PW-1), Mihilal (PW-2) and admitted Ex. P/1 to Ex. P/22C.
The respondents adduced no evidence.

4. The Tribunal assessed the age of Rambharosa as 46 years and income of Rs. 7,000/- per month and adding future prospect of 40% calculated the income at Rs. 8750/-per month and deducting the amount of 1/3rd towards personal expenses and applying the multiplier of 13, the compensation of Rs. 9,09,948/- was awarded in the head of loss of dependency and amount of Rs. 70,000/- was awarded in the head of funeral expenses, loss of consortium and total compensation of Rs. 9,
79,948/- is awarded.
5. This appeal has been preferred on the ground that the income has not been properly assessed.
Even minimum income has not been taken into consideration.
The compensation in customary heads has not been awarded as per law.
The rate of interest is to be modified.

6. Heard.
7.
Learned counsel for the respondents opposed the prayer of the appeal.

8. Perused the record.
9.

The Tribunal ought to have assessed the monthly income of the deceased as Rs. 7,950/- per month and calculating on this ground,in the head of loss of dependency, the compensation is enhanced by Rs. 1,20,000/-, and the amount in the head of loss of consortium is enhanced by
